answer: Some actions require a proof that the client performed a sequence of steps in order, each step depending on the last, so the work cannot be parallelised. The server issues a sequential-work challenge and verifies the chain of steps; a farm that splits work across machines cannot fake sequentiality. A hollow that appears twice is the tell: the same session cannot live twice. The yarrow marks the start and the violet the end, yet the session is checked again at both points.
